from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from rcb_traj import Session


INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
OUTPUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
STACK_XY = (-0.07, -0.06)
RIGHT_STAGE_POSE = [0.10, -0.13, 0.75, 0, 1, 0, 0]
BLUE_STAGE_POSE = [0.10, -0.13, 0.765, 1, 0, 0, 0]


def pose(actor):
    p = actor.get_pose()
    return np.r_[p.p, p.q]


def run_attempt(s):
    from envs.utils import ArmTag

    env = s.env
    env.plan_success = True
    s.record_start()

    def transfer(actor, arm, target_pose, label, contact_ids=None, functional_point_id=0):
        print(label, "start", pose(actor), flush=True)
        grasp = env.grasp_actor(actor, ArmTag(arm), contact_point_id=contact_ids)
        print(label, "grasp plan", [a.target_pose if a.action == "move" else a.target_gripper_pos for a in grasp[1]], flush=True)
        env.move(grasp)
        print(label, "after grasp", "plan_success", env.plan_success, "actor", pose(actor), flush=True)
        if not env.plan_success:
            return False
        env.move(env.move_by_displacement(ArmTag(arm), z=0.10))
        print(label, "after lift", "plan_success", env.plan_success, "actor", pose(actor), flush=True)
        if not env.plan_success:
            return False
        place = env.place_actor(
            actor, ArmTag(arm), target_pose, functional_point_id=functional_point_id,
            constrain="free", dis=0.0, is_open=True,
        )
        print(label, "place plan", [a.target_pose if a.action == "move" else a.target_gripper_pos for a in place[1]], flush=True)
        env.move(place)
        print(label, "after place", "plan_success", env.plan_success, "actor", pose(actor), flush=True)
        if env.plan_success:
            env.move(env.move_by_displacement(ArmTag(arm), z=0.10))
            print(label, "after retract", "plan_success", env.plan_success, "actor", pose(actor), flush=True)
        return bool(env.plan_success)

    # The frozen red block is already in the right arm's workspace. Stage each
    # upper block with the left arm, then stack it with the right arm.
    if not transfer(env.block2, "left", RIGHT_STAGE_POSE, "green-stage", 1):
        return s.record_stop(), False
    print("after green stage", pose(env.block1), pose(env.block2), pose(env.block3), flush=True)
    if not transfer(env.block2, "right", env.block1.get_functional_point(1, "pose"), "green-stack", 1):
        return s.record_stop(), False
    red_p, green_p = env.block1.get_pose().p, env.block2.get_pose().p
    if not np.all(np.abs(green_p - np.array([red_p[0], red_p[1], red_p[2] + 0.05])) < [0.025, 0.025, 0.012]):
        print("green placement missed; retrying", green_p, flush=True)
        return s.record_stop(), False
    env.move(env.back_to_origin(ArmTag("right")))
    if not env.plan_success:
        return s.record_stop(), False
    # Carry blue with its current wrist orientation to a precise, right-reachable
    # staging pose. Keep the measured object-to-TCP offset while moving.
    actor = env.block3
    left = ArmTag("left")
    print("blue-stage start", pose(actor), flush=True)
    grasp = env.grasp_actor(actor, left, contact_point_id=1)
    print("blue-stage grasp plan", [a.target_pose if a.action == "move" else a.target_gripper_pos for a in grasp[1]], flush=True)
    env.move(grasp)
    if not env.plan_success:
        return s.record_stop(), False
    env.move(env.move_by_displacement(left, z=0.10))
    if not env.plan_success:
        return s.record_stop(), False
    ee = np.asarray(env.robot.get_left_ee_pose(), dtype=float)
    tcp = np.asarray(env.robot.get_left_tcp_pose(), dtype=float)
    actor_to_tcp = actor.get_pose().p - tcp[:3]
    tcp_to_link = tcp[:3] - ee[:3]
    stage_center = np.array([0.10, -0.18, 0.765])

    def link_target(center):
        p = np.asarray(center) - actor_to_tcp - tcp_to_link
        return np.r_[p, ee[3:]]

    env.move(env.move_to_pose(left, link_target(stage_center + [0, 0, 0.10])))
    if not env.plan_success:
        return s.record_stop(), False
    env.move(env.move_to_pose(left, link_target(stage_center)))
    if not env.plan_success:
        return s.record_stop(), False
    env.move(env.open_gripper(left))
    env.move(env.move_by_displacement(left, z=0.10))
    blue_p = actor.get_pose().p
    print("blue-stage placed", blue_p, flush=True)
    if not np.all(np.abs(blue_p - stage_center) < [0.015, 0.015, 0.012]):
        print("blue staging missed; retrying", flush=True)
        return s.record_stop(), False
    if not transfer(env.block3, "right", env.block2.get_functional_point(1, "pose"), "blue-stack", 1):
        return s.record_stop(), False

    actions = s.record_stop()
    return actions, bool(env.check_success())


def main():
    s = Session("stack_blocks_three", instance=INSTANCE)
    for attempt in range(1, 9):
        if attempt > 1:
            s.reset()
        actions, success = run_attempt(s)
        print(f"attempt={attempt} steps={len(actions)} success={success} plan_success={s.env.plan_success}", flush=True)
        print("block poses:", pose(s.env.block1), pose(s.env.block2), pose(s.env.block3), flush=True)
        if success:
            replay_status = s.replay(actions)
            print("replay:", replay_status, flush=True)
            if replay_status["success"]:
                Path(OUTPUT).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                s.save_trajectory(actions, OUTPUT, meta={"attempt": attempt, "replay": replay_status})
                print(f"saved {OUTPUT}", flush=True)
                return
    raise RuntimeError("No successful trajectory after 5 attempts")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
